documents.title: Refill request - prenatal vitamin
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Pharmacy e-request for prenatal multivitamin, 90 day supply. Prior prescriber was her old office. Routed to PCP.

documents.title: RE: Refill request - prenatal vitamin
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Approved, 90 days x 3 refills. She takes it for folate with HbSS.

documents.title: Appointment cancelled
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Pt cancelled this afternoon's visit, roads bad up in the hilltowns after the storm and school let out early. Rebooked 3/11 at 3:40.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Interval check, rescheduled from the snow day.
No concerns. Endo in Dec: thyroid normal, stays on methimazole 10 for now, pump unchanged. Winter was quiet for sickle cell - no pain days. Sleeping fine, energy ok with her usual anemia.
Vitals reviewed, normal. Thin, mild pallor. Thyroid slightly full. Lungs clear, RRR. No edema. Pump site clean.
Plan: CBC and BMP. Continue current meds. Hematology in June, endo in June. Physical in September.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Quick note - blood count at your usual level and kidney chemistry normal. See you at the physical in September.

documents.title: Adult sickle cell clinic annual visit
documents.author: hematology
documents.body:
Annual review 6/10/2024 - HbSS.
One mild pain day in the past year, at home. No acute chest, no transfusions, no hospital care. Thyroid controlled on methimazole per endocrinology.
Hgb 8.9 (baseline). Exam: mild pallor, no hepatosplenomegaly palpable, no leg ulcers.
Meningococcal ACWY and B series completed 2023; pneumococcal up to date.
Continue folate. Hydration and heat precautions reviewed for summer. Return 12 months.

events.reason: Graves disease and type 1 diabetes follow-up

documents.title: Endocrinology follow-up
documents.author: endocrinology
documents.body:
Seen 6/17/2024.
Graves: euthyroid on methimazole 10 mg daily, tolerating it. Eye findings unchanged. She prefers to stay on the current dose through the school year rather than test a taper; continue 10 mg.
Type 1 diabetes: A1c improved, see attached. Pump settings unchanged, basal 1.1 u/h.
Return December.

documents.title: Prior authorization - pump supplies
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Insurer sent a renewal form for insulin pump supplies (infusion sets, reservoirs). Endocrinology is the prescriber - called their office, they will complete it. Pt aware.

documents.title: RE: Prior authorization - pump supplies
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Endo confirms renewal approved through 8/2025.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Yearly exam. 34 now. New class this fall, 22 kids.
T1DM: endo 6/24, A1c 7.1, pump unchanged. Retina due next month.
Graves: still methimazole 10; thyroid normal.
HbSS: hematology 6/24, Hgb 8.9, one pain day in the year.
No hospital or ED care since last physical. No new meds.
Exam: comfortable. Vitals normal. HEENT: mild proptosis, pale conjunctivae. Neck: thyroid mildly full, nontender. Cardiac and lung exams normal. Abdomen soft, nontender. Extremities warm without swelling, no leg ulcers. Feet: sensation intact to monofilament, pulses palpable.
Screening: Pap 2023 normal/HPV neg - next 2028. PHQ-2 0.
Plan: CBC, CMP, lipids, UACR, TSH. Flu and COVID at nurse visit. See in spring.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Susan - your yearly labs look stable. Kidney numbers and urine protein normal, thyroid normal, cholesterol fine, blood count at your usual. Nothing to change.

documents.title: RE: Lab results
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Thank you! I'll book the flu shot for after school one day in October.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Immunizations
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Flu (trivalent) L deltoid and 2024-25 COVID R deltoid. Afebrile, no acute complaints. Observed 15 min without issue.

documents.title: Retina examination letter
documents.author: ophthalmology
documents.body:
Annual diabetic retinal exam 11/7/2024.
VA 20/20 OD, 20/20 OS. IOP normal. Dilated: few scattered microaneurysms both eyes, unchanged from 2023. OCT macula normal both eyes. No proliferative disease, no sickle peripheral changes.
Impression: mild NPDR OU without macular edema, stable. See in one year.

events.reason: Graves disease and type 1 diabetes follow-up

documents.title: Endocrinology follow-up
documents.author: endocrinology
documents.body:
Office visit 12/9/2024 - Graves disease, type 1 diabetes.
Well. Euthyroid, methimazole 10 mg daily continued. A1c a little higher with the holidays approaching; reviewed bolus timing. No pump changes. Labs attached.
Next visit June.
[Faxed 2/10/25 in response to records request 2/3/25.]

documents.title: School health plan
documents.author: patient
documents.body: The school nurse is updating my health plan for the classroom. Could you write a short letter saying I have type 1 diabetes with a pump and sickle cell, and that I may need to step out to check sugar, eat, or drink water? Thanks so much.

documents.title: Letter for school
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: To the school health office: Ms. Susan Mensah is my patient. She has type 1 diabetes managed with an insulin pump and sickle cell disease. She may need brief breaks to check her glucose, treat a low with food or juice, and keep well hydrated, and should have water available in the classroom. Please contact our office with questions.

documents.title: Records request
documents.author: MA
documents.body: No note yet from endocrinology for December visit. Called their office; they will fax. Request logged.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
6-month check-in.
Doing well. Endo Dec note finally came (A1c 7.4, no changes, methimazole 10 continued). No sickle pain days this winter. Retina Nov stable.
Meds: insulin aspart pump, methimazole 10 mg, prenatal vitamin.
Exam: vitals normal. Mild pallor. Thyroid slightly full. CV/resp normal. No swelling.
Plan: CBC, BMP. Specialists in June. Annual in fall.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs from Monday look good - hemoglobin steady at your usual and kidney function normal.

documents.title: Adult sickle cell clinic annual visit
documents.author: hematology
documents.body:
Sickle Cell Program annual note, visit 6/9/2025.
HbSS, clinically quiet. No pain episodes needing medical care this year. No transfusion history in adulthood.
Hgb 8.5, within her range.
Exam: mild scleral pallor, no adenopathy, no leg ulcers.
Continue folate supplement. Vaccines current for asplenia. Return one year.

events.reason: Graves disease and type 1 diabetes follow-up

documents.title: Endocrinology follow-up
documents.author: endocrinology
documents.body:
Follow-up 6/23/2025.
Graves disease: euthyroid; methimazole 10 mg daily, unchanged.
Type 1 diabetes: A1c up a bit; long school year, more evening snacking without boluses. Reviewed. Pump settings unchanged.
Return 6 months.

documents.title: No-show
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Pt did not join video visit. Called x1, voicemail. Left message to rebook if she still wants it; otherwise see her at the fall physical.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Physical, early slot before school.
Missed the July video check (forgot, camp week). Feels fine.
DM1: endo June, A1c 7.6, working on evening boluses. Pump same. Retina due Nov.
Graves: methimazole 10, euthyroid in June.
Sickle cell: hematology June, Hgb 8.5, quiet year.
Meds: aspart via pump, methimazole 10 mg daily, prenatal vitamin daily. Allergies sulfa (hives), PCN (rash).
PHQ-2 0, GAD-7 2.
Exam: NAD. Vitals ok. Pale conjunctivae. Mild proptosis, no lid lag. Thyroid mildly enlarged, smooth. Lungs clear, heart regular without murmur. Abdomen benign. Legs without swelling. Monofilament normal both feet.
A/P: chronic conditions stable with specialists. Annual labs: CBC, CMP, lipids, A1c, UACR, TSH. Flu shot given today. Next visit spring.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Susan - labs from Friday are in. Blood count, thyroid, cholesterol and urine protein are all fine. A1c 7.5, about the same as June. Nothing new to do. Have a good fall.

documents.title: Retina examination letter
documents.author: ophthalmology
documents.body:
Diabetic eye exam 11/10/2025. VA 20/20 both eyes. Dilated fundus: scattered microaneurysms OU, unchanged. Macula dry on OCT. No neovascularization, periphery flat without sickle changes.
Mild NPDR OU, stable. Return 12 months.

documents.body: Pharmacy requesting renewal, prenatal vitamin daily, 90 day supply. Last seen 10/3/25.

documents.title: RE: Refill request - prenatal vitamin
documents.author: PCP
